terms.comment: Linnaeus’s name for the cacao tree, Greek θεός and βρῶμα, “food of the gods”; a learned name rather than the everyday word.

phrases.english: Which do you prefer, chocolate or cream?

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. chocolate.
